name: Heather L. Apicella
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Boca Raton, Florida
education: Nova Southeastern University Shepard Broad College of Law
about: Experienced in the field of law practice for over 15 years, attorney Heather L. Apicella is the founder and functions as the principal of the Boca Raton law firm Apicella Law Group, P.A., in Florida. She is a board-certified specialist in the field of marital and family law by The Florida Bar. She is an esteemed family law attorney focusing on legal matters, including:

Licensed to practice by The Florida Bar in 2006, Ms. Apicella completed her law degree cum laude from Nova Southeastern University. She is a 2002 Bachelor of Science graduate of the Florida State University, Tallahassee. She worked with various prestigious law firms right after graduation and was made partner with time.

Ms. Apicella has served as a chair of the Family Law Sections of both The Florida Bar and the Broward County Bar Association. Apart from this, she has served in several important positions at various prominent legal associations and was honored with the Practice Section Chair Award for her leadership skills as the chair of the Family Law Section.

A firm believer in the power of communication, Ms. Apicella has honed her skills to interact effectively with her clients which enables them to have a clear idea about their case and be reassured about the effort that she puts into them. In addition, Ms. Apicella holds memberships in the National Association of Distinguished Counsel, the Broward County Bar Association, the South Palm Beach County Bar Association and the Palm Beach County Bar Association as well.
